problem: Production could publish Dutch content under /en/* because an incomplete immutable English cache combined with STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=0 and STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=0 made the localized builder return an untranslated English estate.
root_cause: The production cache requirement was relaxed while network translation remained disabled. Build transforms also introduced a volatile version timestamp into the translation corpus.
prevention: The complete immutable English cache is versioned and must validate against the post-build public corpus.
Volatile build metadata such as the visible version timestamp is excluded from translation.
Production browser readback must reject Dutch pricing H1 on /en/prijzen.
